page.overview:
Who is Hope?

Ying was still pregnant with Hope when their village was invaded by the Rough Rhinos, forcing the family to flee to Ba Sing Se. Hope was born just outside the Outer Wall of the city, with Katara providing pivotal assistance.

When Hope was born, the love and togetherness exhibited by her parents inspired Aang to feel hopeful again, as he had succumbed to his feelings of anger and sadness over losing Appa. It was for this reason that Ying named her daughter Hope.

Hope and her parents successfully made it to Ba Sing Se, but the Fire Nation proceeded to capture the city shortly thereafter. Hope cried in her mother's arms as Fire Nation soldiers marched through the city.
